$comment: Pinned to a concrete SDK version, not the bare band '11.0.100-preview.7'.
A band is not a resolvable SDK version: actions/setup-dotnet@v5 looks the value up
verbatim and fails with 'Could not find .NET Core SDK with version = 11.0.100-preview.7'.
(v4 happened to tolerate it, which is how this slipped through initially.)
rollForward:latestFeature still allows newer 11.0.1xx SDKs, so pinning the concrete
version costs nothing while keeping CI and local installs reproducible.
The band itself is recorded in eng/baselines.json > target.sdkBand, and CI checks
that this version belongs to it.
